result.how_ranked: Healthy servers first; servers built for the need (named in title or main description) before those that only mention it; then by BOTERNITY score out of 100 (reliability, protocol conformance, tool definitions, context cost), then 30-day availability, then latency. Checked every night from outside; no tool is called.

trust.source: BOTERNITY MCP Index (nightly checks of the official MCP registry)
trust.verification_method: Each server is contacted from outside like an MCP client (initialize, tools/list, ping, error handling), no tool is called; score out of 100 by the published method.
limitations: One check per night from one location (Europe); a server can change between checks.
The score measures protocol behaviour and tool definitions, not the quality or safety of what the tools do.
